       COALESCE(SUM(wc.cost_eur), 0) AS total_warranty_cost,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS num_vehicles,
       COALESCE(SUM(wc.cost_eur), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.vin) AS cost_per_vehicle
